messages:
Ava CSM: @Marta :wave: kicking off Redwood onboarding for Helios Labs. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and timeline.
Marta (Customer PM): Thanks Ava. High level: integrate chat + embeddings into search, SLO: p95 < 400ms, cost target -20% vs current. Stakeholders: me, Liam (dev), legal (TBD).
Liam (Dev Lead): Hi — we'll own integration. Current infra is Node 18 servers, 2x replicas. Need SDK examples and webhook flows.
Rohit (Solutions): I'll own the integration checklist and run a spike this week. Recommend starting with our hosted API then move to Dedicated for steady throughput.
Sabrina (Success Ops): Noted renewal: contract up in 11 months. Early renewal risk flagged since they use competitor in prod. We'll track adoption metrics weekly.
onboard-bot: New kickoff added to onboarding-tracker: https://redwood.internal/boards/OLp123
Ava CSM: Proposed 30/60/90: 30d - POC + demo, 60d - beta w/ 3 internal teams, 90d - go-live + SKUs. Agree?
Marta (Customer PM): Yes. Add success criteria: accuracy >= baseline on 3 eval sets, embed latency < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%.
Liam (Dev Lead): We need sample prompts, eval datasets. @Rohit can you share embedding payload example? Also access to staging API key.
Rohit (Solutions): Will drop snippet and staging key request. Snippet:
```
const resp = await redwood.generate({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'query text' })
console.log(resp.embedding.length)
```
Rohit (Solutions): I'll also schedule a 60m workshop next Tue for SDK + observability walkthrough :calendar: 
Sabrina (Success Ops): I'll set up weekly 30min check-ins (Weds 10am PT) and add adoption KPIs: active users, tokens/day, eval pass rate.
Ava CSM: Action items: 1) Rohit share snippet + staging key (by EOD Fri). 2) Liam provide test dataset (by Mon). 3) Sabrina create tracker (by tomorrow). 4) Marta confirm legal contact.
Marta (Customer PM): Legal: cc'ing them on the invite now — looped in. :white_check_mark:
Liam (Dev Lead): Will upload a small eval set to the tracker tonight.
Ava CSM: Flagging renewal risk mitigation: schedule executive business review at 60d, capture early wins and cost delta.
Sabrina (Success Ops): Noted — I'll draft exec deck template and share in #cs-shared-assets.
onboard-bot: Reminder: kickoff follow-up tasks due in 7 days.
Ava CSM: Great progress. Next step: Rohit to post staging key + invite calendar for Tue workshop. Thanks team :raised_hands:
